title: SAM Analyst
description:
*About the job*

***Our Team:***

*The Software Asset Management team is part of the Digital Strategy and Operations department within Sanofi.*

*Our mission is to ensure software assets are governed and monitored throughout their lifecycle within our organization to ensure proper governance, optimize investments, maintain compliance with licensing agreements, and enhance security across all business units globally.*

*The SAM team operates globally, covering all Sanofi business units (R&D, industrial, commercial, support functions) across all geographies, with strong partnerships with Procurement, Legal, and IT teams.*

*We have successfully implemented the ServiceNow SAM Pro module to monitor complex software license compliance for key vendors, historically supported through a Managed Service. We are now transitioning away from this Managed Service and internalizing this capability, initially focusing on Microsoft, Oracle, and TIBCO publishers. This role will focus specifically on Oracle and TIBCO, working alongside a teammate covering Microsoft.*

*In parallel, we are developing new SAM tools leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Agile mode, to automate existing processes and create innovative ones.*

*We are looking for a motivated team member with solid technical foundations who is eager to grow into the Software Asset Management space — a domain at the crossroads of IT, Procurement, and Legal. Your primary focus will be to support the internalization of our ServiceNow SAM Pro capability; as we mature, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the design and development of innovative tools.*

***Main responsibilities:***

* *Drive the internalization of software asset compliance monitoring, focusing on Oracle and TIBCO publishers*
* *Configure and maintain ServiceNow SAM Pro to meet Sanofi's specific requirements, including regular exchanges with internal clients (software product owners) to ensure alignment with their needs*
* *Build and maintain dashboards and reports to provide visibility into software assets*
* *Train and support users on new processes and tools*
* *Contribute to data quality and integrity across the ServiceNow SAM platform*
* *Document processes and technical solutions*
* *Lead integration efforts between SAM Pro and other ServiceNow modules or external systems*
* *Contribute to the design and development of new SAM tools, including AI-powered solutions, working in Agile mode (as the team matures)*

*About you*

* ***Experience****: 4-6 years of experience in IT, ITSM, or a related technical field; no prior SAM/licensing expertise required — genuine interest in developing skills in this space is key*
* ***Learning & Development Expectations****:*
* *Commitment to upskilling on ServiceNow SAM Pro through hands-on practice, training, and collaboration with the team*
* *Willingness to learn Software Asset Management principles (licensing models, compliance, vendor management)*
* *Ability to thrive in an Agile working environment (sprints, stand-ups, retrospectives, continuous improvement)*
* *Proactive approach to self-learning and staying current with SAM and AI-driven automation trends*
* ***Soft skills****:*
* *Strong appetite for learning and growing into a new technical domain*
* *Rigorous, methodical approach with attention to detail and data accuracy*
* *Good communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to work across global teams*
* *Pragmatic, results-oriented mindset*
* *Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders*
* *Self-motivated with ability to work independently and as part of a team*
* *Ability to work with high autonomy and take ownership of deliverables*
* *Willingness to share knowledge and support junior team members (if relevant)*
* ***Technical skills****:*
* *Strong technical background, with solid foundations in IT systems, infrastructure, or software engineering*
* *Good foundational knowledge of the ServiceNow platform (SAM Pro module is a plus)*
* *Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies*
* *Experience with JIRA / Confluence is a plus*
* *Interest in AI-driven tools and automation is a plus*
* *Experience with software discovery tools is a plus*
* ***Education****:*
* *Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field*
* *4-8 years professional working experience in Information Technology*
* ***Languages****: Fluent English (written and verbal)*
* ***Travel requirements****: Occasional short-term international travel (approximately 1%)*

*Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary*

*Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.*

*At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.*

*Watch our* *ALL IN video**and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at* *sanofi.com**!*

title: Principal ServiceNow Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
==================

Cubic Transportation Systems

**Company Details:**
====================

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  
  
We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

**Job Details:**
================

**Job Summary:** The Principal ServiceNow Business Analyst will play a key role in bridging business needs with ServiceNow platform capabilities. This role focuses on understanding business requirements, driving process improvements, and delivering functional solutions within the ServiceNow ecosystem.

The individual will partner closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to design, implement, and optimize ServiceNow solutions aligned with organizational goals. This position operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and requires strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead requirements gathering sessions with business stakeholders to understand and document ServiceNow-related needs
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Serve as a ServiceNow functional SME, providing guidance on platform capabilities and best practices
* Perform gap analysis and recommend optimal solutions leveraging ServiceNow modules
* Work with Cubic internal stakeholders to plan and execute ServiceNow onboarding tasks for Cubic's Customer programs, ensuring consistency of process and technology adoption
* Collaborate with developers and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements
* Support configuration discussions and validate solutions to meet business expectations
* Drive process improvements across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, and other ServiceNow modules
* Facilitate workshops, demos, and user training sessions to support adoption
* Define and execute UAT plans, ensuring business sign-off before production release
* Support audit activities related to Incident, Request, Change, and Asset management processes
* Maintain documentation, including business requirements, process flows, and solution designs
* Act as a liaison between business users, IT teams, and external vendors
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance ServiceNow usage across the organization
* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System, security, and HSE policies

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

**Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst with strong exposure to ServiceNow
* Proven experience in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, and process mapping
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, CMDB, CSDM, ITAM, HRSD, or ITOM
* Experience working on end-to-end ServiceNow implementations or enhancements
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes and frameworks
* Ability to perform gap analysis and recommend scalable solutions
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
* Strong documentation skills (BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows)
* Good understanding of ServiceNow configurations and capabilities (technical depth is a plus, not mandatory)
* Exposure to integrations and APIs is desirable

**Certifications (Preferred):**

* ITIL Foundation Certification
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Implementation Specialist (any module)

**Personal Qualities:**

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities
* Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and accuracy
* Collaborative approach with the ability to influence cross-functional teams
* Proactive, self-driven, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment

‎

**Worker Type:**
================

Employee

‎

*We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: Mendix Developers
description:
**Job Summary**

Serve as a product specialist focusing on Mendix based applications translating business needs into secure and scalable low code solutions for global stakeholders in a hybrid work model. Collaborate with cross functional teams to enhance digital journeys for life and annuities insurance processes while ensuring high quality delivery maintainability and user satisfaction across the product lifecycle.

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to analyze product requirements and convert them into detailed Mendix application specifications that support measurable business outcomes in a hybrid working environment.
* Design Mendix application features with emphasis on scalability performance and maintainability so that product releases remain stable and easy to enhance over time.
* Configure and build Mendix modules microflows and pages to deliver intuitive user experiences that streamline complex insurance and financial service processes.
* Optimize existing Mendix applications by refining data models refactoring logic and improving user journeys to reduce operational effort and processing time.
* Coordinate with quality engineering teams to define test scenarios support defect triage and validate fixes so that releases meet agreed acceptance criteria and compliance needs.
* Document functional behavior configuration decisions and user guidance for Mendix solutions to ensure smooth knowledge transfer and efficient onboarding of new team members.
* Partner with operations and support teams to monitor Mendix application health analyze incidents and implement preventive improvements that enhance availability and reliability.
* Engage with product owners to prioritize backlog items estimate effort and plan sprints that align with organizational priorities and customer value objectives.
* Apply secure coding and configuration practices within Mendix to protect sensitive customer and policyholder data and to comply with enterprise security standards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by proposing enhancements to development workflows reuse patterns and automation that increase delivery speed and consistency.
* Collaborate with integration specialists to connect Mendix applications with core systems external services and data sources using approved enterprise integration patterns.
* Communicate progress risks and dependencies clearly to project partners ensuring transparent status reporting and timely escalation of potential delivery issues.
* Guide peers by sharing Mendix product knowledge reusable components and best practices so that the overall capability of the product team improves.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate solid hands on experience in Mendix development including data modeling microflow design and front end configuration gained over three to six years of professional work.
* Show practical experience in end to end software delivery within agile teams including refinement development testing support and release activities.
* Exhibit familiarity with life and annuities insurance concepts such as policy management claims handling and underwriting processes that inform effective product design.
* Apply knowledge of relational databases basic query optimization and structured data handling when building and tuning Mendix applications.
* Display strong problem solving and analytical skills that enable fast understanding of business issues and effective design of Mendix based solutions.
* Demonstrate clear written and verbal communication skills that support collaboration with business stakeholders analysts architects and quality engineers.
* Show readiness to work in a hybrid model during day shifts while coordinating effectively with distributed teams across multiple locations.

**Certifications Required**

Mendix Intermediate or Advanced Developer certification is highly valued.

title: Cyber security / Associate Director, Watch Commander
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr Associate Director, Watch Commander

The Opportunity

Global Cybersecurity Operations (GCO) provides coordinated network defence services to detect and respond to information and cybersecurity threats to HSBC assets worldwide. This role sits within Cybersecurity Incident Management and Response and helps protect HSBC customers, the HSBC brand, shareholder value and HSBC information and financial assets. As Watch Commander you'll run one of the 24x7 Cybersecurity Operations teams spanning multiple service lines and ensure smooth handovers as global shifts change. You'll keep an intelligence-led view of current and emerging threats so monitoring, alerting and response can be anticipated and where possible put in place early. You'll work closely with GCO colleagues and wider IT teams to keep core response technology and processes fit for purpose and to reduce high-volume low-risk activity through automation and orchestration. Success looks like clear decision-making under pressure, consistent incident response execution and measurable improvements in detection quality and operational effectiveness.

What you'll be doing

* Manage a local Cybersecurity Operations team across multiple service lines to deliver 24x7 protection for the bank and its customers
* Oversee smooth shift handovers across global teams so incidents and priorities are transferred clearly and consistently
* Maintain an up-to-date, intelligence-led view of the threat landscape to anticipate impacts to HSBC services and deploy pre-emptive monitoring and response
* Partner with wider GCO and IT teams to keep operational tooling and underlying technology capabilities effective against current and emerging threats
* Identify opportunities to automate and orchestrate processes to improve efficiency and focus analyst time on higher-risk work
* Coordinate development and maintenance of incident response playbooks with GCO and relevant business and function stakeholders
* Support creation and implementation of new detections and use cases to strengthen monitoring and alerting
* Produce management information for the CSIRT mission with clear analysis and data to support informed decisions and control improvements

What we're looking for

* Bring substantial experience in cybersecurity operations leadership including team development, recruitment and capability improvement
* Apply strong decision-making in time-critical incident response scenarios including crisis management frameworks and communications
* Communicate complex technical issues clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including OWASP, ISO2700x, PCI DSS, GLBA, EU data security and privacy acts, FFIEC, CIS and NIST
* Use hands-on expertise with core security technologies such as IDS-IPS-HIPS, anti-malware, firewalls, proxies and related tooling
* Interpret common network protocols and perform network protocol analysis across enterprise environments
* Apply incident response tools, techniques and processes to contain, mitigate and remediate threats effectively
* Hold CEH, EnCE, SANS GSEC, GCIH, GCIA, CISSP or equivalent certification, or bring equivalent demonstrable experience

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.


Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.


In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys, and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.


GIS Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.


**Job Description\***


The IAM Analyst (Mainframe Provisioning and Security) is responsible for administering and governing user, privileged, service, and technical identities across the mainframe environment, including RACF, z/OS, z/VM, OMVS, and related security domains. The role ensures timely, accurate, and risk\-aligned access provisioning, de\-provisioning, role maintenance, and entitlement administration in accordance with enterprise IAM policies, segregation of duties, and regulatory requirements.


This role partners with Lines of Business, account owners, and infrastructure teams to deliver secure access lifecycle management for critical mainframe resources. It also drives process modernization through automation, JCL and scripting, AI\-assisted operational analysis, control monitoring, and continuous improvement to reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, and improve service quality and turnaround time.


**Responsibilities\***


* Administer and govern mainframe identities and access across RACF, z/OS, z/VM, OMVS, datasets, groups, resource classes, started tasks, and privileged accounts, ensuring least privilege and policy compliance.
* Perform end\-to\-end access provisioning, modification, and de\-provisioning for user, functional, service, and robotic IDs, with strong validation of approvals, entitlements, and segregation\-of\-duties requirements.
* Manage access for sensitive mainframe resources including dataset profiles, generic profiles, groups, OMVS segments, USS access, surrogate access, and command/resource controls.
* Handle escalations, exception requests, urgent access restorations, and complex provisioning scenarios across multiple LPARs and environments while maintaining control evidence and operational discipline.
* Drive process improvement and automation using JCL, REXX, Shell, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting where applicable, reducing manual processing and improving control consistency.
* Develop and maintain operational scripts, batch workflows, and JCL\-based utilities for bulk updates, reconciliation, reporting, evidence collection, and controlled remediation activities.
* Ensure secure administration of privileged, emergency, and non\-human accounts by applying strong controls for ownership, monitoring, authentication, and decommissioning.
* Perform timely de\-provisioning and access removals and ensuring stale access, orphan IDs, and toxic combinations are identified and remediated.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures, and technical documentation for provisioning workflows, command execution standards, and automated jobs.
* Partner with security and platform teams to strengthen the mainframe control environment through continuous monitoring, metrics, control testing and strategic modernization initiatives.

**Requirements\***


**Education\*** BE/BTECH/MCA/MSC (IT) equivalent (Any Technical Degree)


**Certifications (If Any):**


* IBM Security zSecure, RACF administration, SailPoint, CyberArk etc.
* Governance, risk, or audit\-aligned certifications such as CRISC, CISM, or CISA are also desirable.

**Experience Range\*** 8\-10\+ Years


**Foundational skills\***


* 8\+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, with strong hands\-on experience in Mainframe access provisioning, security administration, and control execution.
* Strong understanding of IAM architecture, access lifecycle management, RBAC, privileged access concepts, segregation of duties, and risk\-based control frameworks.
* Deep knowledge of mainframe security administration across RACF, z/OS, z/VM, OMVS/USS, and familiarity with ACF2 or Top Secret concepts in multi\-platform environments.
* Hands\-on experience with automation and scripting such as JCL, REXX, Shell, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent tools used for provisioning, reconciliation, reporting, and workflow optimization.
* Experience with bulk data handling, evidence preparation, and reporting using Excel, macros, or data analysis tooling for operational and audit support.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate access decisions, control requirements, technical issues, and remediation actions to business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to adapt to evolving security tools, AI\-assisted operational capabilities, and changing regulatory or control expectations in a high\-risk environment.
* Experience working in a cross\-functional, team\-oriented environment involving IAM, infrastructure \& platform security.
* Self\-starter with strong troubleshooting capability, operational ownership, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a time\-sensitive provisioning environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret access models, troubleshoot security errors, and identify process or control gaps.
* Demonstrated risk\-oriented mindset with experience supporting access reviews, audit responses, issue remediation, control validation, and policy compliance.
* Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and Lines of Business.
* Ability to provide senior\-level judgment, mentor junior analysts, and influence process and control improvements across the provisioning function.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and reporting tools, especially Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Visio, for analysis, communication, documentation, and control evidence preparation.

**Desired skills**


* Proficiency in documenting detailed procedures, work instructions, control steps, operational runbooks, and evidence artifacts for mainframe IAM processes.
* Strong technical knowledge of RACF administration, resource class security, dataset protection, OMVS/USS, z/VM concepts, JCL, and familiarity with tools such as zSecure.
* Ability to operate effectively across technology, cyber, applications and business teams.
* Drive automation by standardizing workflows, reducing manual touchpoints, improving turnaround time

**Work Timings:** 7:30 to 16:30 **/** 11:30 to 20:30 (IST) \[Rotational / As per Business Requirement]


**Job Location:** MUM / HYD

title: Cloud Security Analyst
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.  

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
Overview:

As a Cloud Analyst supporting the Seismic product suite, you will help us secure our cloud footprint across five cloud providers and a wide array of delivery stacks. You will help us strengthen our monitoring capabilities, develop common controls across all systems, measure implementations against industry benchmarks, and help us to protect our customers against emerging threats – including agentic AI risk. Sitting at the intersection of security operations and cloud platform engineering, you will build automated controls, triage alerts, address toil, and partner with our product engineering team to solve problems.  


Who you are::
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in Cloud Security, DevSecOps, or Infrastructure Security.
* Capable of managing cloud posture , reviewing CIS Benchmarks, and working with security logging/SIEM solutions.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and tuning WAF policies and rules (e.g. Cloudflare WAF, AWS WAF).
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) for audit and remediation.
* Proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar language for fetching telemetry, interacting with cloud APIs, and automating security tasks.
* Experienced with least\-privilege principles, service accounts, API key lifecycles, and machine\-to\-machine authentication.

**Nice to Have (Optional)**  

* Experience with GCP, OCI, or posture management.
* Experience with SOAR platforms and automated security workflows (e.g. Workato, Tines).
* Knowledge of detection engineering fundamentals, rule authoring, and threat intelligence.
* Exposure to security AI/ML workloads, agentic AI frameworks, non\-human identity management, or automated API integrations.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Security, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Security\+, CCSP or other relevant specialty certifications).

  


What you'll be doing::
* **Identity \& Agentic AI Security** Enforce identity, access, and privilege boundaries for automated agents, service accounts, and API integrations interacting with cloud infrastructure.
* **Cloud Infrastructure Monitoring** Build, tune, and maintain security monitoring across our Cloudflare Web Application Firewall (WAF), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and cloud\-focused SIEM logs. Work to reduce alerts, improve remediation times, and create runbooks for standardized responses.
* **Hardening \& Compliance**: Conduct regular CIS Benchmark audits across cloud environments, identify posture drift, and collaborate with teams to remediate findings.
* **Automation \& Scripting**: Write clean scripts (AI skills, Python, Bash, etc.) to automate alert triage, remediate misconfigurations, and integrate security tooling into existing workflows.
* **Cloud Security Operations \& Escalation**: Own escalation paths for cloud security alerts, participate in incident investigation, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident documentation.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Collaborate with Cloud Security Engineering and Cloud Operations to advance shared security objectives through clear ownership, effective prioritization, transparent ticketing, and timely resolution.
* **Culture \& Global Alignment**: Gain experience and mentorship from seasoned security professionals and contribute to a growing and collaborative global security team.

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.

* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.

* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.
